name: Empty box with a magnetic field
blurb: Floor-density gas threaded by a uniform magnetic field: what the tools add drags the field with it, and is held by it.

featured.label: Box size
featured.tip: Side of the box: in code units (one is a solar radius) or, with the readouts in physical units, in the unit picked beside it. Changing it builds the run again

featured.label: Field strength B
featured.tip: Strength of the uniform field, in units where the magnetic pressure is B² / 2 (code units): 0.1 has the pressure of gas of unit density at a temperature of 0.005. Changing it starts the run again
